commit e365b56bbac2c2becc82f5003dbbe3d8f56e147d
Author:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Thu Dec 11 10:52:17 2025 +0000
Commit:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Thu Dec 11 10:52:17 2025 +0000

    Bug 2001547 - Ensure sane initial conditions for compose and message windows. r=mkmelin
    
    
    The test fails because the window is too small and has no area for the test to click on. This
    patch removes any existing state information (like size and position) for compose and message
    windows from the XulStore.
    
    This test also prevents the "know you rights" banner to appear, which is often seen in failed
    tests to have focus and apparently an open context menu, which indicates the test clicked on
    the bar instead of the content. Another indicator for the bar being an issue is that these
    tests do *not* fail in debug tests, where the bar is prevented automatically [1].
    
    [1]: https://searchfox.org/comm-central/rev/669c3f6761d8c835b2e34ddd1784f610fbc7975a/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js#25-28
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D275950

diff --git a/mail/components/extensions/test/browser/browser.toml b/mail/components/extensions/test/browser/browser.toml
index e6cd06341c3..67c43c6579f 100644
--- a/mail/components/extensions/test/browser/browser.toml
+++ b/mail/components/extensions/test/browser/browser.toml
@@ -8,6 +8,9 @@ prefs = [
   "mailnews.message_display.disable_remote_image=false",
   "mailnews.start_page.override_url=about:blank",
   "mailnews.start_page.url=about:blank",
+  # Suppress the bar because it sometimes steals focus or causes other unexpected
+  # issues.
+  "mail.rights.override=true",
 ]
 subsuite = "thunderbird"
 support-files = [
diff --git a/mail/components/extensions/test/browser/head.js b/mail/components/extensions/test/browser/head.js
index 16098420bc5..885e63eceb5 100644
--- a/mail/components/extensions/test/browser/head.js
+++ b/mail/components/extensions/test/browser/head.js
@@ -62,6 +62,14 @@ add_setup(async () => {
     }
     is(tabmail.tabInfo.length, 1, "One tab open from start");
   }
+  // Remove state information (for example position and size) for the compose and
+  // message window, which might have leaked in from previous tests.
+  Services.xulStore.removeDocument(
+    "chrome://messenger/content/messengercompose/messengercompose.xhtml"
+  );
+  Services.xulStore.removeDocument(
+    "chrome://messenger/content/messageWindow.xhtml"
+  );
 });
 
 // Keep tack of the origial value of the pref extensions.webextensions.uuids to
title: Bug 2001547 - Ensure sane initial conditions for compose and message windows. r=mkmelin
